question: Which of the following is the most common omega-3 fatty acid found in vegetable oils, nuts (especially walnuts), flaxseed and leafy vegetables that help prevent heart disease and stroke?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Alpha-linolenic Acid (ALA)__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Omega-3 fatty acids **are found in foods, such as fish and flaxseed, and in dietary supplements, such as fish oil.
 
• The most common omega-3 fatty acid found in vegetable oils, nuts (especially walnuts), flaxseed, and leafy vegetables that help prevent heart disease and stroke is Alpha-linolenic acid (ALA).
 
• The three main **omega-3 fatty acids** are
 
 
• Alpha-linolenic acid (ALA)
 
• Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA)
 
• Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA)
 
 
 
• Alpha-linolenic acid is found mainly in plant oils such as flaxseed, soybean, and canola oils. 
 
• Other sources of Omega-3 fatty acids include walnuts, chia seeds, hemp seeds, edamame, seaweed, and algae.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Benefits of Omega-3 fatty acids:

 
• Lower blood pressure
 
• Reduce triglycerides
 
• Slow the development of plaque in the arteries
 
• Reduces the chance of abnormal heart rhythm
 
• Reduces the likelihood of heart attack and stroke
 
• Lessen the chance of sudden cardiac death in people with heart disease
